title: Rabbi Berechyah bar Yitzchak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Midrash Shmuel 20:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Shmuel.20.4) (Hyman cites 20:7). Hyman cites the statement in the work abbreviated דו״ר, 2:20, as Rabbi Berechyah in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak. It also appears in [Tosafot, Sotah 42b](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Sotah.42b.5.1), under Me'ah; Hyman says that there too the attribution should read “in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The correction changes an apparent father-son attribution into a report in Yitzchak’s name.

[Ruth Rabbah 2:20](https://www.sefaria.org/Ruth_Rabbah.2.20) gives Rabbi Berechyah’s teaching about Orpah’s forty steps in Rabbi Yitzchak’s name. The linked Midrash Shmuel and Tosafot have bar or berabbi Yitzchak. Hyman proposes reading “in the name of Rabbi Yitzchak” in Tosafot. The abbreviation דו״ר remains uncertain.
